source_baseline: DDD-BDM-010 + 2026-09-14 G1 revalidation + global Strategic convergence + 2026-09-15 full MVP Tactical convergence

participants.name: Business Connectivity
participants.responsibility: Business Process, Connectivity Need and business attribution/current justification truth.

participants.name: Access Governance
participants.responsibility: Access Request history, bilateral approval obligations/decisions and current grant/withdrawal truth.

participants.name: Access Policy
participants.responsibility: Current authoritative semantic Policy Rule truth keyed by governed interaction subject.

participants.name: Authority Management
participants.responsibility: Effective Actor/Action/ResponsibilityScope authority derived from membership, role and scope assignment facts.

participants.name: Resource Catalogue
participants.responsibility: Resource identity/lifecycle, at most one effective HostAddress-or-Prefix realization per Resource/time for current scope, scope affiliation/responsibility.

participants.name: Application Communication Catalogue
participants.responsibility: Application/Component/Interaction identities and immutable InteractionContractRevision traffic snapshots.

participants.name: Application Deployment
participants.responsibility: Logical ApplicationDeployment identity/continuity and complete current Component-to-Resource placement-set truth.

participants.name: Network Enforcement Placement
participants.responsibility: Candidate Firewall and policy-locator relevance for technical address pairs.

participants.name: Technical Access Evidence
participants.responsibility: Immutable source-qualified technical evidence with source/time/provenance.

participants.name: Access Policy Realization
participants.responsibility: Source-neutral realization assessment, semantic delta, accepted additive change design and verification.

participants.name: Network Environment Operations
participants.responsibility: Controlled target mutation identity, authority, preconditions, outcome and execution provenance.

source/destination ApplicationDeploymentRef + complete current endpoint Component placement sets

ResourceRef + logicalTime -> effective AddressSpace[0..1] = HostAddress | Prefix with resolution/provenance

invariants: Business Connectivity Need references stable Interaction meaning; concrete Access Governance subject references the exact immutable InteractionContractRevision.
ACC owns Application/Component/Interaction/InteractionContractRevision semantics and not deployment placement.
Material Interaction traffic change creates a new immutable InteractionContractRevision without changing Interaction identity.
Application Deployment owns logical deployment identity and complete current Component-to-Resource placement-set truth.
ComponentPlacement is an MVP relation value (ComponentRef, ResourceRef); zero, one or many placements per Component are valid and exact duplicate pairs are not.
Ordinary scaling, Resource migration and placement replacement do not change ApplicationDeployment identity while logical deployment continuity remains.
Resource Catalogue owns Resource identity/lifecycle, scope affiliation/responsibility and effective AddressSpace.
For current scope one Resource has at most one effective AddressSpace at one logical time, represented as HostAddress or Prefix.
Application Deployment references ResourceRef only and owns no endpoint/address selection.
GovernedInteractionSubject identity is InteractionContractRevisionRef + source/destination ApplicationDeploymentRef.
Access Governance MVP requires exactly one distinct applicable Responsibility Scope per governance side; zero or several fail closed.
A material approval-obligation change withdraws current authorization without changing governed-subject identity.
Historical Access Requests/approvals cannot silently restore withdrawn current authorization.
Authority Management evaluates exact Actor + Action + ResponsibilityScope + effectiveTime authority and Resource responsibility metadata never substitutes for it.
Unknown authority fails closed for protected actions; historical decisions preserve the authority evidence valid at decision time.
Required Policy Materialization is derived composition; unresolved is not empty required policy or APR drift.
The first MVP NEP edge accepts only HostAddress-to-HostAddress TrafficPairs; Prefix remains upstream truth and yields unresolved materialization until Prefix-aware NEP semantics are accepted.
APR compares complete required/configured effective permit semantics by ComparisonScope firewallId + accessListName using exact common/missing/excess algebra.
APR assessment, semantic delta and VerifiedChangeIntent are immutable/derived values for MVP and require no invented durable remediation aggregate.
MVP remediation is additive-only: missing may produce ENSURE-PERMIT VerifiedChangeIntent; excess is report/audit evidence and not automatic removal authority.
Provider rendering must preserve verified semantic intent and fail closed when equivalence cannot be established.
NEO owns controlled execution and may not reinterpret APR intent or rendered artifact semantics.
Applied or immediate execution Verified is not final semantic convergence proof.
No Shared Kernel is accepted between target Bounded Contexts.
explicit_future_extensions: Detailed BusinessProcess retirement/archive, criticality and duplicate-Need policy when a concrete journey requires them.
Richer ApplicationDeployment lifecycle/history when observable behavior requires it.
ACC draft/publish/version-presentation workflow beyond immutable contract snapshots.
Nested groups, role inheritance, explicit deny/ABAC or quorum authority semantics.
Generalized Access Governance approval semantics when several Responsibility Scopes apply to one side.
Prefix-aware NEP TrafficPair routing/override matching semantics without host enumeration.
Managed-policy ownership and automatic removal/narrowing semantics for APR excess.
Richer APR remediation vocabulary or durable remediation-plan lifecycle beyond additive ENSURE-PERMIT.
Multiple simultaneous Resource addresses/prefixes, interfaces, endpoint purpose, VIP and deployment-specific network exposure require a future confirmed use case and affected-edge reopen.
Production provider transport, generic rollback and multi-target transaction semantics are downstream architecture extensions, not current DDD blockers.
